question: Which of the following tests aims to determine the loss of mass of the tablets by abrasion processes?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Friability" -> "determines the loss of mass of tablets by abrasion processes" -> 95% CHAIN: "Friability" -> "measures the ability of tablets to withstand mechanical stress" -> "determines tablet durability" -> 95%
analysis: The test that aims to determine the loss of mass of tablets by abrasion processes is the Friability test. This test involves rotating the tablets in a drum and then measuring the percentage of weight loss due to abrasion.
